findings.title: Target-bound accepted elevation
findings.closureScope: Eight failing starting-candidate controls repaired; A→B→A, stale/absent/simulated weather and known zero covered; narrow post-native-admission hook.

findings.title: Currentness and scheduler comparison
findings.closureScope: Retain CP8.3 epoch and native-clock mechanism; adopt 30-second ceiling; ordinary currentness safe. Accelerated availability separately OPEN CP9-F102.

findings.title: Worker loss may block the prayer event loop
findings.closureScope: Physical worker loss withdraws optional sky; failure path 2255.5→17.8 ms heartbeat in matched control; retries restore a worker. Broader CPU stress remains OPEN CP9-F101.

findings.title: Composition, exposure, camera and lunar alternatives
findings.closureScope: Matched no-colour uniform-transmission operator pixels coincide; native colour/meter policies differ. No measured calibration superiority established; no incompatible parameter transplant. PBR/material and exact operator invariants retained.

findings.title: Page exit cleanup and persisted return
findings.closureScope: Paired suspend/resume with generation fencing, only persisted pageshow resumes. Controlled ordering passes; real BFCache remains CP9-F103.

findings.title: Second cloud owner admitted accidentally
findings.closureScope: Native physical engine refuses second cloud attenuation/glow; own local-light policy unchanged.

findings.title: Ignored scintillation disable parameter
findings.closureScope: Use actual strength:0 contract; no unintended sparsely sampled twinkle. Smooth optional scintillation is not invented as a mandatory residual.

findings.title: Obsolete native synthetic diagnostic ownership
findings.closureScope: Additive compact realSky diagnostics preserve native fields; legacy counters labelled inactive and optional diagnostic exceptions isolated.

findings.title: Per-pixel native transform reads

findings.title: Redundant unchanged native presentation
findings.closureScope: Only exact physical-frame/support/geometry/cloud/PBR identity skips pixels; cached-pixel metadata refresh regression found and fixed. No cadence, alpha or source change.

findings.title: Hard-coded browser launcher
findings.closureScope: Explicit engine/executable selection with no fallback; five tests. This closes invocation portability only, not target-platform acceptance.

findings.title: The five-trial loaded CPU×4 responsiveness target remains unmet after the verified mask hoist and exact-input presentation cache

evidence.observation: Five sequential trials per condition; inspect candidate cases separately from the native baseline. This pre-seal run precedes only the diagnostic-metadata refresh fix; final archive qualification reruns the exact final runtime.

Exact final runtime sampled under CPU×4; CP9 top-self linearToSrgb 1437.258 ms, encodeFrame 1307.661 ms, nativeForeground 727.751 ms and getImageData 601.960 ms across a 12224.768 ms sample interval. Inclusive times overlap; (program) is not assigned to an invented JS owner.
Mask hoist already closed: exact samples and roughly 9× median improvement. Do not redo or claim this as new work.
Identical-input skip and changes to PBR pixels, cloud pixels, cutout geometry, physical frame and metadata are all discriminating controls.

findings.title: Accelerated native time advances beyond a physical job’s 30-second accepted-UTC eligibility window before completion

evidence.observation: At 1/10/60/600×, new accepted frames = 3/2/0/0. Visibility = 65/16/0/0 samples out of 99/100/99/92 in this retained run; consult exact JSON. All frozen recoveries current and no stale publications. First-current and post-first-current metrics explicitly distinguish warm-up.
